answer: Each identity may endorse only 6 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 456 aliases need 456 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. A vault of doubt is healthy, a whisper of proof is required, and a knoll of patience is the price of a clean panel.
